description: Health facility layers: Pakistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Pakistan. This dataset contains the geographic location of the health facilities located in the context of the FATA Health Department, WHO and OCHA- Pakistan. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Pakistan. Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, health, health facilities, hxl. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2021-12-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support health-facility access and emergency-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
